| `prowler` | `apiserver_encryption_provider_config_set` | `kube-system/Pod/kube-apiserver-demo-control-plane` | NIS2 Art.21(2)(h), DORA Art.9, DORA RTS 2024/1774 Art.6, NIS2 CIR 2024/2690 Annex 9.1, ISO27001:2022 A.8.24 |  | guidance only | No code is generated because enabling secrets encryption changes etcd contents and cannot be turned off again. Write an EncryptionConfiguration file with the aescbc or kms provider, start the API server with --encryption-provider-config pointing at it, then rewrite the existing secrets so etcd stores them encrypted: kubectl get secrets --all-namespaces -o json \| kubectl replace -f -. Store the config and its key safely: etcd cannot read the secrets back without them. |
